boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time on campus or in Ruston, using public-access and no-charge information from Louisiana Tech and the City of Ruston.

cards.title: See the School of Design Galleries
cards.subtitle: Jay Taylor Visual Arts Center, 1 Mayfield Ave.
cards.notes: Drop into the School of Design’s two gallery spaces and talk through the work together; weekday gallery access is free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission campus art stop with rotating contemporary work.
cards.evidence_claim: Louisiana Tech lists its School of Design Galleries as free and open to the public, Monday through Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Louisiana Tech School of Design Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; free and open to the public. Check the gallery page before visiting for reception exceptions.

cards.entity_name: Browse Federal Depository documents at Prescott Memorial Library
cards.title: Browse federal documents together
cards.subtitle: Prescott Memorial Library, 201 Mayfield Ave.
cards.notes: Choose a topic and explore the federal document collection side by side; materials are available for free public use during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A research-minded hang among a large federal documents collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Prescott Memorial Library is open to the public and welcomes use of its federal government document collections; its policies state free public access.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; use collections during library open hours. Borrowing has separate ID or courtesy-card requirements.

cards.entity_name: Explore Louisiana state documents at Prescott Memorial Library
cards.title: Explore Louisiana documents
cards.subtitle: Prescott Memorial Library, 201 Mayfield Ave.
cards.notes: Compare old and current state publications or maps at the library’s depository shelves; public access to state documents is free during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A free, locally grounded browse through Louisiana government publications.
cards.evidence_claim: Louisiana Tech’s Government Documents policy says state depository materials may be accessed by any member of the public during library open hours and are provided free for use.
cards.access_notes: State documents are on the library’s second floor; access them during library open hours. Copying may carry a fee.

cards.entity_name: Use Prescott Memorial Library guest computers
cards.title: Settle in at a guest computer
cards.subtitle: Prescott Memorial Library, 201 Mayfield Ave.
cards.notes: Meet up for a low-key research session using the library’s designated guest computers, which provide free public internet access during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A free indoor option for browsing, planning, or shared research.
cards.evidence_claim: Louisiana Tech states that designated guest computers on Prescott Memorial Library’s second floor offer free public internet access.
cards.access_notes: Guest computers are on the second floor and available during library open hours; they are intended for library catalog and government-publication access.

cards.title: Scan a shared project
cards.subtitle: Prescott Memorial Library, 201 Mayfield Ave.
cards.notes: Bring notes, clippings, or a permitted document and digitize it together; the library specifically identifies its scanners as free to use.
cards.short_summary: A practical no-cost stop for preserving or sharing paper materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Louisiana Tech’s visitor information states that Prescott Memorial Library scanners are free to use.
cards.source_title: Louisiana Tech Prescott Memorial Library Visitors and Alumni
cards.access_notes: Scanners are free; printing is restricted to active Louisiana Tech community members and photocopies cost 10¢ per page.

cards.title: Catch a Science Seminar
cards.subtitle: Louisiana Tech campus; select Thursdays
cards.notes: Check the seminar schedule, then bring a friend for a science or engineering talk and post-talk conversation; the series is free and public.
cards.short_summary: A campus lecture series spanning science, engineering, and related topics.
cards.evidence_claim: Louisiana Tech says its Science Seminars occur on select Thursdays in fall, winter, and spring and are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Louisiana Tech College of Engineering & Science Outreach and Seminars
cards.access_notes: Held on select Thursdays during fall, winter, and spring quarters; confirm the current seminar location and date before going.

cards.title: Meet at R. L. Cook Park
cards.subtitle: Ruston city park
cards.notes: Use the open park area for a picnic blanket, conversation, or an easy walk; the city keeps adjoining park areas open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A named Ruston park for an unstructured outdoor meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruston Parks and Recreation lists R. L. Cook Park and states that adjoining city-park areas remain open and available to the public at all times.
cards.source_title: City of Ruston Parks and Recreation Reservations
cards.access_notes: Use unreserved adjoining park areas; pavilion reservations are optional and separately priced.

cards.title: Take a lap at Duncan Park
cards.subtitle: Ruston city park
cards.notes: Pick a meeting point and walk or sit in the open park area; no purchase or admission is required when you are not reserving a pavilion.
cards.short_summary: A public Ruston green space suited to a simple walk-and-talk.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruston Parks and Recreation lists Duncan Park and says adjoining city-park areas remain open and available to the public at all times.
cards.source_title: City of Ruston Parks and Recreation Reservations
cards.access_notes: Open adjoining park areas are public; a paid pavilion reservation is optional and applies only to the reserved facility.

cards.title: Walk Huckleberry Trails Park
cards.subtitle: Ruston city park
cards.notes: Make it a casual group walk or pause outdoors between classes; use the public park area without reserving a pavilion or buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A named city park for a free outdoor reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruston Parks and Recreation lists Huckleberry Trails Park and states that adjoining park areas remain open and available to the public at all times.
cards.source_title: City of Ruston Parks and Recreation Reservations
cards.access_notes: Public adjoining areas are available without a reservation; pavilion reservations are optional and priced separately.

cards.title: Hang out at Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: Ruston city park
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a quiet outdoor break in the public park area; Memorial Park is first-come, first-served and not reservable.
cards.short_summary: A named, first-come Ruston park for a no-cost outdoor hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruston Parks and Recreation lists Memorial Park as first-come, first-served and says adjoining city-park areas remain open and available to the public at all times.
cards.source_title: City of Ruston Parks and Recreation Reservations
cards.access_notes: Memorial Park is first-come, first-served and not reservable; follow city ordinances while using the public park.
